runtime.type: official prebuilt static executable; not built from source

changes: Make mdadm a conditional dependency under QUICKSTART_INCLUDE_RAID, default n; retain all other upstream runtime dependencies.
Preserve the official prebuilt executable with RSTRIP disabled and its source archive SHA256 pinned.
Add luci-compat to the LuCI runtime dependencies.
Use one Lua capability module to detect executable /sbin/mdadm for both the controller and template.
Publish RAID capability through the existing quickstart_features array; condition the sidebar menu, dashboard link, SPA route and all three RAID list requests on it.
Do not synthesize successful API responses, suppress new errors or alter upstream request handlers.
Keep upstream package-input validation and shell argument handling.
Materialize the upstream zh_Hans translation alias as the canonical directory and omit the redundant legacy alias.
Normalize copied text files to LF for the Linux build environment.
Add a Node.js regression test covering absent, disabled and enabled RAID capabilities, all three request sites, dashboard link, SPA route and request error propagation.
Detect the native APK package manager capability and route QuickStart software-source configuration to its LuCI page, instead of offering the backend OpenWrt-only mirror selector.
Declare luci-app-package-manager as an explicit dependency so the native source configuration target is installed.
Add software-source navigation tests for native APK capability, legacy dialog lifecycle and preservation of real diagnostic errors.
Retain the official 0.13.1 backend and all existing network parameter APIs. Preserve backend DNS/offline diagnoses; use one authenticated LuCI base-index probe as the sole source-health authority.
Probe the configured actual APK packages.adb or OPKG Packages.gz with TLS verification and bounded curl requests. Missing feeds, transport errors and HTTP failures cannot report success.
Clear previous successful health on probe/API failures, display probe unavailability explicitly, and cache successful checks for 90 seconds and failures for 5 seconds.
This reachability diagnostic does not replace package-manager signature validation or certify all repositories and dependencies.

upstream_replacement_assertions.change: route APK source configuration to native manager
